store.description: By Tech Nomad Ted, TheTechNomad.com. Formerly Nomad MCP. Nomad AI Bridge lets your AI connect to and control your Cardputer Zero. It is an MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT & Codex: AI apps (Claude, ChatGPT developer mode, OpenAI Codex and other MCP clients) can use the device from wherever it has internet: run commands and long background jobs, read, write and edit files, install and run programs (with an Admin / sudo switch), take screenshots of the built-in screen, and run TNT AV Net Tools checks when that app is installed. It connects out through a free ngrok tunnel, so no ports are opened on the network. A setup wizard with QR codes walks you through making the free ngrok account and pasting the token from your phone, shows the connector address as a QR code, and pairs your AI app with a one-time code shown on this screen. See which AI apps are connected, disconnect one or all, set permissions and watch live activity from the keyboard. A no-account quick test tunnel and Cloudflare are also available. Powered by ngrok. Not affiliated with ngrok, Anthropic or OpenAI; Claude, ChatGPT and Codex are trademarks of their owners.
